definitions.Delta: Delta(r0; n) = LSE_r1[B + I](r0) - LSE_r1 B = log E_{r1 ~ q_B}[exp I(r0, r1)], q_B = softmax(B); log p(r0|n) = A + Delta + const_n
definitions.lin: Delta_lin: least squares of within-episode-centred Delta on [1, n_1..n_5], one regression per value (uniform over values)
definitions.linP: Delta_lin^P: least squares weighted by the joint posterior's variance, sum_m Var_P[Delta - W^T x] (quadratic approx. of the CE fit)
definitions.CE: best linear rule minus A (CE to the joint marginals, L-BFGS, logits W^T [n/T, 1])
definitions.R2_unif: 1 - sum (Delta_c - D_c)^2 / sum Delta_c^2 over test episodes and values (centred over values), pair-weighted
definitions.R2_post: 1 - sum_m Var_P(Delta - D) / sum_m Var_P(Delta), P = joint marginal posterior
definitions.shapley: linear part = 1/2[(acc(A+D) - acc(A)) + (acc(joint) - acc(A + Delta - D))]; nonlinear = (joint - naive) - linear
definitions.contrast: episodes where joint and naive argmax differ: Delta(r_J) - Delta(r_N) vs D(r_J) - D(r_N); overturns = D(r_J) - D(r_N) > A(r_N) - A(r_J)
definitions.se: se_pairs: SE of the pair-weighted mean over the 1275 pairs; se_episodes: from episode sampling with pairs fixed
